name: McGinty's Best Thing Smoking BBQ
h1: Grimes County barbecue, *smoked by Mark McGinty.*
lead: Brisket, loaded plates and daily specials like Fish Friday and Soul Food Sunday on South Lasalle Street. Rated 4.8 stars by 198 Google reviewers.
about: Mark McGinty built a reputation for his barbecue around Navasota before he ever opened a restaurant. Friends and the community pushed him to open one, and McGinty's Best Thing Smoking BBQ has been a Grimes County staple since.

KBTX profiled it in 2024 as a Black-owned barbecue spot becoming a staple in Grimes County, and The Navasota Examiner named it in its Best of Grimes County. Mark says his loaded plates and brisket put him on the map.
services: The cut Mark says put McGinty's on the map.
